items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: And then, uh, Alvin left and he got Keg Noletti. Ernie Keg Noletti.

ctx.x: Oh, okay. Do, um, uh, yeah, I had some questions about Bourbon Street and, and just working Bourbon Street in general. And, had, did you, did you work Bourbon Street at all in the?

Off and on. But the first regular job I had on, on Bourbon Street was in 19, uh, 1960. Uh-huh. I was playing with Bill Matthews Band. Uh-huh. You ever heard of Bill Matthews? Sure. Yeah. Well, see, it was originally Papa Celestan Band. Okay. And then Papa Celestan didn't want to work every night because he found out if he worked with spot jobs, he could make more. Uh-huh. So he, he left, he quit his whole band and got another band. And his band used Alvin Alcorn for trumpet. He replaced Papa Celestan. And Bill…
